object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Look up the PDF program in an installed Mellon whose tools folder holds the PDF program and its package cache, with another copy on the search path; then remove the installed copy. Run the PDF program. Expected: the installed copy is used before the search path, and the installed package cache is passed to it; without the installed copy the search path's copy is used.
